_comment: Portal-specific field mapping (SRS §6, Phase 0 deliverable). Reloaded on every sync — edit without a code change. Entries marked CONFIRM must be checked against the live portal's crm.status.list / crm.dealcategory.list output.

pipelineFamilies._comment: SRS §6.5 item 3: flagship parsed from deal category NAME prefix (case-insensitive). Anything unmatched falls into 'custom' (FR-6 catch-all). CONFIRM: 'Nural Schemes' is listed as a Sales variant in the prototype. byCategoryId (set from the dashboard Data Mapping section) overrides the prefix rule for one pipeline.

dealStages._comment: FR-4 canonical buckets. byStageId wins over the name patterns; STAGE_SEMANTIC_ID S/F always maps to won/lost. Purchase Order removed (not used in this sales process) — a deal sitting in such a stage shows as Unmapped rather than disappearing.

stageProbabilities._comment: SRS §6.5 item 1: static win probability (0–1). byStageId overrides byBucket. Populate starting values with the business in Phase 0.

leadStatuses._comment: SRS §6.5 item 5 (CONFIRM): STATUS_ID → funnel bucket. byStatusId wins; otherwise matched on the status display NAME.

leadSources._comment: FR-5: merges happen before ranking; excluded sources never shown.

risk._comment: FR-9 thresholds in days, measured from MOVED_TIME.

missingValue._comment: FR-7 Error List: open deals and active leads (leadBuckets) with an error. checkValue: no potential value. checkCustomer: no customer name. includeLeads: list leads too.
